name: Wizard
description:
A multi-step task: a Stepper, the current step's content, and Back, Next (or Skip for an
optional step) and Finish. Next runs the step's `validate` first and stays with its message
when it fails; the stepper marks the step. Moving between steps focuses the new step and
announces it. Steps keep their state: the Wizard only shows one at a time.
signature: ({ steps, value: valueProp, defaultValue, onValueChange, onFinish, navigation, orientation, finishLabel, footerStart, locale, labels, className, "aria-label": ariaLabel, }: WizardProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The first step shown when uncontrolled. Default: the first step.

props.name: footerStart
props.description: Content at the start of the footer (a Cancel button, or a draft note).

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ readonly steps: "Steps"; readonly stepOf: (step: number, total: number) => string; readonly complete: "complete"; readonly current: "current"; readonly error: "needs attention"; readonly optional: "Optional"; readonly skipped: "skipped"; readonly back: "Back"; readonly next: "Next"; readonly finish: "Finish"; readonly finishing: "Finishing…"; readonly finished: "Done"; readonly skip: "Skip"; }> | undefined

props.name: locale
props.description: Formatting and wording locale; defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider.

props.name: navigation
props.description: Which steps the person may jump back to from the stepper. Default `visited`.

props.name: onFinish
props.description: Runs after the last step validates; the Finish button shows its progress and outcome.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the next value when a person changes the control. Update controlled state here.

props.name: orientation
props.description: `horizontal` (default): steps above the content; `vertical`: a rail of steps beside it.

props.name: steps
props.description: The steps, in order, with their content and checks.

props.name: value
props.description: The current step's id. Pair with `onValueChange` to control it.
